map.对焦超焦距 使用指南: Focusing at the Hyperfocal Distance User Guide
map.对焦超焦距工具计算并应用超焦距对焦时的清晰范围（从 H/2 至无穷远），适合风光: The focusing at hyperfocal distance tool computes and applies the sharp range when focusing at the hyperfocal distance (from H/2 to infinity), which maximizes depth of field for landscape photography and helps set the focus distance.
map.H = f² / (N · c)对焦 H 时，景深从 H/2 到无穷远: H = f^2 / (N * c). When focusing at H, depth of field runs from H/2 to infinity.
map.超焦距对焦时求近界与远界。: Find the near and far limits when focusing at the hyperfocal distance.
map.确认从哪到无穷清晰。: Confirm from where to infinity stays sharp.
map.：24mm、f/11、c=0.03：H ≈ 1.76m，对焦 H 时近界 = H: 24mm, f/11, c = 0.03: H = about 1.76m; when focusing at H the near limit = H/2 = about 0.88m and the far limit is infinity, so the frame is sharp from your feet to the horizon.
map.：同 24mm f/16：H ≈ 1.22m，近界 ≈ 0.61m，远界仍无穷，: Same 24mm at f/16: H = about 1.22m, near limit = about 0.61m, far limit still infinity, so the near field is sharper with slightly more diffraction.
map.近界为什么是 H/2？: Why is the near limit H/2?
map.对焦超焦距时，最近清晰点恰为 H/2、最远无穷，这是超焦距定义的几何结果。: When focusing at the hyperfocal distance, the nearest sharp point is exactly H/2 and the farthest is infinity, which is the geometric result of the hyperfocal distance definition.
map.收太小有坏处吗？: Is stopping down too far harmful?
map.f/16+ 衍射使整体略软，风光常用 f/8–f/11 平衡景深与锐度。: At f/16 and beyond diffraction makes the whole frame slightly soft; landscape work usually uses f/8-f/11 to balance depth of field and sharpness.
